concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/xdl-lite/requirements.md XDL1-SR-007, realized by XDL1-ARCH-04, XDL1-ARCH-05, XDL1-ARCH-06 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Compile every declared fault exactly once with resolved target, declared fault class (faultKind), simulation trigger, duration, typed parameters, activation, recovery, and maturity.
Order deterministically per detailed-design.md 11.2 with a stable tie-break and reject competing declared order.
Activate, inject, clear, schedule, or execute no fault and invoke no fault runtime.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
